messages:
Darya Ivanov: manager opened an appeal for an SDE3 -> SDE4 promo that was denied at calibration (panel upheld E3). they want to know: can we escalate, and what paperwork to attach for an appeal? also worried about pay compression with a peer who was promoted last month.
Rohan Mehta: short: we have a formal appeal flow. manager should submit an Appeal Packet to CompCom within 14 days with new evidence not in the original packet (fresh metrics, stakeholder letters, or missed artifacts). don't resend the same docs. include a compression note if relevant.
Elena Garcia: what counts as "new evidence"? manager asks if customer emails or OKR outcomes qualify.
Rohan Mehta: qualifies: dated customer impact emails, post-hoc dashboards showing sustained impact, cross-team endorsements (product/infra), or a transcribed snippet from a tech review meeting that shows ownership. Personal testimonials from peers alone are weak.
Darya Ivanov: what's the timeline and potential outcomes? manager needs to tell the IC.
CompCom: timeline: intake review in 3 business days, appeal panel scheduled within 2 weeks. outcomes: uphold, level-bump with retro to effective date, or level-bump with phased increase. If approved with retro, retro upper cap = $20,000 USD by default unless Director+ signoff. we notify payroll for processing and FX note.
payroll-bot: note: if retro crosses countries, payroll will split payments per jurisdiction and apply local tax rules. provide exact effective date and past paystubs in the packet to speed processing.
Elena Garcia: manager also asked whether we can do an interim lump-sum to address compression while appeal is pending. allowed?
Rohan Mehta: interim adjustments are possible but rare. require VP approval and must be labeled "compression relief provisional"; they are taxable and not a guarantee of level change. include rationale and duration in the request.
Darya Ivanov: ok. can we get a short checklist i can paste into the appeal form?
CompCom: paste this into the Appeal Packet:
```
- Summary (1 paragraph) of why new evidence changes the leveling call
- New evidence attachments (dated dashboards, customer emails, stakeholder letters)
- Compression context: anonymized peer comps + why compression is material
- Requested remedy (level bump, retro dates, or provisional relief)
- Estimated retro (USD) and currency note if outside US
- If retro > $20k or spans >1 jurisdiction, note Director+ approval needed
- Tag @CompCom and @payroll-bot in the submission
```
Rohan Mehta: add one more: include a short mitigation plan if we take provisional relief (how you'll align peers after decision).
Darya Ivanov: thanks. one more: how do we communicate to the IC while appeal is ongoing? manager wants a template.
CompCom: suggested language: "We submitted an appeal to the compensation committee. This is an internal review of leveling decisions and may take up to two weeks. We will update you after the panel. No payroll or offer changes will be finalized until the review completes." mark as "internal pending".
Elena Garcia: perfect  i'll prep the packet and ping compcom for intake.
payroll-bot: Appeal packet received (#A-3388). Intake queued.
Darya Ivanov: appreciate the fast answers  i'll loop the manager in.
